svg.text: TypeScript · LangChain · LangGraph · Agentic Tool Routing
"Show top 5 customers by spend" · "Find jackets similar to a parka" · "Search bluetooth (fuzzy)"
Filter by field value (status, date, price)
All three approaches are registered as separate LangGraph tools — the LLM autonomously routes each question to the correct tool.
